lines.text: 从那以后，杰克点菜的时候，先问菜是用什么做的，再看名字好不好听。
lines.py: cóng nà yǐ hòu, Jié kè diǎn cài de shí hou, xiān wèn cài shì yòng shén me zuò de, zài kàn míng zi hǎo bù hǎo tīng.
lines.en: After that, whenever Jack orders, he first asks what a dish is made of, and only then whether its name sounds nice.
